result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks and a narrow roadway that naturally encourages lower vehicle speeds. However, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks and suffers from reduced visibility due to vehicles parked close to the corners.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, which fails to alert drivers to pedestrian crossing points.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked right up to the intersection corner block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the intersection.

result.summary: A narrow residential street with row houses and parallel parking on both sides. While sidewalks are provided, there is a complete lack of marked crossings or traffic calming measures, and parked vehicles significantly obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and make pedestrians more visible.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a wide, paved sidewalk and mature trees. While the pedestrian path is clear, there is a lack of marked crossings or traffic control devices, and large vegetation may limit visibility at potential crossing points.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large flowering tree on the right side may obscure pedestrians from the view of drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, overhanging the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
